title: Fortune 10 scientist with free-energy and teleportation technology
summary: Steven Greer tells of Fortune 10 scientist with free-energy and teleportation technology, about 2025 at Los Angeles, US, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: guy flies in super genius he can build uh over free energy plasma things he can do teleportation

plain: Steven Greer, a UFO researcher and activist, told podcast host Jesse Michels that in 2025 a scientist linked to one of America's ten largest companies flew in to meet him in Los Angeles. Greer calls the man a super genius and says he can build 'free energy' plasma devices, meaning machines said to produce power without fuel, and can do teleportation. If true, it would mean world-changing technology already exists out of public view.
